services.name: Yamaha Waverunner
services.desc: Duration 1 Hour About New Yamaha Waverunners! There is no better time out on the water than with a jetski rental from Tierra Verde Boat Rentals! Come and explore the waters surrounding St. Pete Beach, Passagrille, Shell Island, Sand Dollar Key, Boca Ceiga Bay, Tierra Verde, and the Intracoastal Waterway. These new WaveRunners provide a safe and smooth ride for 1-2 passengers while shooting across the waters at speeds of up to 45mph! With Yamaha’s new intuitive dual throttle RiDE System, there is not a safer or more maneuverable jetski out there! services.name: 18' Keywest Center Console
services.desc: Duration 6 Hours About Not too big and not too small, this is the perfect center console to island hop or fish the flats. Depth finder, Chart Plotter and 115hp of awesomeness sends you across the water at about 40mph and gets you where you need to be. Perfect for the couple to take to the sandbar or the father that wants to catch some fish with the kiddos. Best part… It doesn’t break the bank! Boat Information USCG rated for 4 people (Recommended for Comfort: 3 Adults) Fishing gear is allowed on this boat! Coolers and alcohol are allowed onboard. Bimini Top provides shade for most of the boat. Full Coast Guard Approved Safety Package onboard. Rules and Regulations: Adequate boating

services.name: 20’ Hurricane Deckboat
services.desc: Duration 6 Hours About Got some friends and looking for day of something to do? This 20ft Deck boat could be just right for you. Not too big and not too small, a Bimini top to provide shade for all! Head to the islands for a couple of laughs or bring a tube and have a blast! Go for an hour, or two, or four! Or make it a day and just explore! Whatever your needs this boat is just right. Make it your horse and you be the knight! Were we rhyming that whole time? Weird... services.name: 24’ Hurricane Deckboat
services.desc: Duration 6 Hours About Welcome to the big league. If Ishmael rented this boat when he was after the white whale he might of actually got him. With 150hp strapped to the back and enough space to fit a rhino and an elephant, this boat can cater a load of entertainment. Grab some skis or a tube and head out to Boca Ciega Bay for some afternoon water sports or pack up some chairs and noodle and drift into paradise on the islands. services.name: 22′ Key West Center Console
services.desc: Duration 6 Hours About Newest boat in our fleet, this center console with T top is rigged for fishing or just cruising around the area. It’s 225 HP Yamaha will get you there quickly. Equipped with depth finder, chart plotter, and a large bait well, she is set up for a productive day on the water. Large 30 gallon cooler also provides extra seating, and the bow has a raised platform for better access to the fish, or for your partner to sun themselves while you catch that big one. We’ve powered her with a 225 HP Yamaha to get you there faster. Boat Information USCG rated for 7 people (recommended for comfort: 4-5 adults) Fishing gear is allowed on this boat rental – and fishing is encouraged!
